lead.t: Post-renal: Relieve the obstruction (e.g., urinary catheterisation, ureteric stents, nephrostomy).

b: Consider catheterisation in patients who are severely ill or require accurate monitoring of urine output.
Urine output helps assess renal perfusion and response to resuscitation.

snip.t: Post-renal: Relieve the obstruction (e.g., urinary catheterisation, ureteric stents, nephrostomy).
Urinary catheterisation in selected patients requiring close urine-output monitoring.
